source_analysis.skill: Finding the Reduced Row Echelon Form of a 3x3 System That Is Already in Row Echelon Form
reasoning_steps: Construct augmented matrix preserving coefficients, signs and RHS.
Where needed normalize pivots (lesson introduction); observed question bank has unit pivots.
R2 <- R2-c R3 and R1 <- R1-b R3 when coefficients nonzero.
R1 <- R1-a R2 when coefficient nonzero.
Read the RHS of [I|s] as ordered solution; select the requested matrix, vector or textual assignment.
invariants: 3 variables in order x,y,z; nonsingular upper triangular coefficient matrix.
Worked solutions show actual elimination stages and skip operations on zero entries.
Single correct choice with distinct distractors; exact complete observed banks required on replay.
permitted_variations: Change a12,a13,a23 signs and magnitudes independently, including zero where source supports skipped elimination.
Change all RHS values and solution coordinates, including zero and negative values.
Vary which incorrect candidate nearly matches, which coordinate is wrong, sign/error structure and correct choice position; none are mandated by the mathematical method.
Vary matrix/vector/text response profiles as observed; keep the requested representation synchronized.
Change coefficients while preserving solution by recomputing RHS (irrelevant to final answer, relevant to row operations); change RHS holding coefficients fixed to require a new solution.
